# Security Policies and Procedures

This document outlines security procedures and policies for the `JoomGallery` Project.

## Reporting a Bug

The `JoomGallery friends` team take all security bugs seriously. We are following some specific procedures when dealing with these issues.

If you find a possible vulnerability, please report it to `JoomGallery friends` via email at team@joomgallerfirends.net

Thank you for helping improving the security of the `JoomGallery` component.

## Security releases

In order to maintain an efficient and fast release process, we are dealing vulnerabilities using in common way using PullRequest's against the `master` branch and handle it as a [Patch Release](https://github.com/JoomGalleryfriends/JoomGallery/blob/master/docs/Releasestrategy_en.md#patch-release-eg-401).

## Communication

We are communicating Security Releases together with the the Joomla! Security Strike Team - [JSST](https://developer.joomla.org/security). Where we create official CVE's with the Joomla! tagging. We are following the Vulnerability Threat Levels from the Joomla! project and the Joomla! Security Strike Team.

If desired, the reporter will be recognized in the CVE in the desired format.

The releases are delivered using the official Joomla! update channels including a changelog with corresponding security marking. Additionally a news article on our [project website](https://www.joomgalleryfriends.net/) with additional information for the website administrators will be published and also visible in the control panel of the component.
